MerchantApplication: has many Decision (Decision.item_id where item_type = MerchantApplication)
may be linked from many ChatMessage (ChatMessage.linked_item_id)
ReconException: has many Decision (Decision.item_id where item_type = ReconException)
may be linked from many ChatMessage (ChatMessage.linked_item_id)
FlaggedTransaction: has many Decision (Decision.item_id where item_type = FlaggedTransaction)
may be linked from many ChatMessage (ChatMessage.linked_item_id)
Decision: belongs to one MerchantApplication, ReconException or FlaggedTransaction (via item_type + item_id)
ChatMessage: optionally links to one queue item (MerchantApplication, ReconException or FlaggedTransaction) via linked_item_id, shown as 'Open in review card'
belongs to one agent's chat history; chat is read-only and never creates Decisions
ActivityLogEntry: references one queue item (MerchantApplication, ReconException or FlaggedTransaction) via target
human entries optionally reference the Decision that produced them via decision_id
